Inspect other artifacts and completed-item distributions as diagnostics, but do not claim global inventory equality. This restrictive cell may be suppressed; preserve its requested scope rather than broadening it silently.

Answer from the measured evidence or identify which comparison remains unresolved. Do not infer damage share, survival time, attack frequency, gold value or causal performance from final boards; treat missing/suppressed results as unknown, not zero.

Support any exact same-holder multi-item claim with occurrence-bound loadout evidence or a one-copy guard across all stars plus separate star and item-count conditions; separate holder predicates can otherwise match items on different same-name copies.
